title: Being Final Close Context
description: Close context for a metamorphosis that reached a terminal being — no further #[Be] attribute.

final.description: Fully-qualified class name of the terminal being.

prop.description: Public readonly properties of the terminal being.

been.description: Ordered events the terminal being curated into its own `$been` carrier via `with()`. Each entry is a semantic-logger context (object). Omitted when the terminal being has no `$been` or curated nothing.
